sourceNotes: 音频新增输出静音快捷操作和耳机断开音量保护
日历支持分别显示或隐藏宜忌、时辰吉凶与黄历详细信息
音频输出快捷切换默认选择内置扬声器与可识别的耳机，保留已有自定义选择
优化历史图表键盘浏览、按钮对比度和网络连接状态提示
简化卸载权限失败提示，支持打开访达处理应用后继续清理残留，错误详情可按需展开
修复日历方向键翻月被误拦截的问题，统一日历设置入口
出口检测区分实测、推断与失败，不再将 IPv6 检测失败显示为防护生效

en: Add a quick action to mute audio output and headphone disconnection protection: when falling back to built-in speakers, reduce volume above 20% to 20% without raising lower volume or unmuting.
Show or hide auspicious activities, hourly fortunes, and detailed Chinese almanac information independently in the calendar.
Default audio output shortcut cycling to built-in speakers and recognized headphones, preserving existing custom selections.
Improve keyboard navigation in history charts, button contrast, and network connection status messages.
Simplify uninstall permission errors and let users continue removing leftovers after handling the app in Finder, with expandable error details.
Fix calendar arrow-key month navigation being intercepted and unify the calendar settings entry point.
Distinguish measured, inferred, and failed egress checks; no longer report failed IPv6 checks as active protection.
